name: Immich Sync
description: Sync your screenshots to Immich and browse your Immich albums.
author: amn-96

changelog.v1.3.0: Added ability to apply tags in Immich to synced screenshots. This will need a new api key with proper permissions so sign in again or update the key accordingly. Minor UI layout improvements.
changelog.v1.2.0: Added a muOS build (Immich Sync.muxapp, attached to the GitHub release). NextUI builds are unchanged.
changelog.v1.1.1: Releases are now tagged and published automatically when pak.json changes on main.
changelog.v1.1.0: Validated H700 support, added left and right stick image viewer nav, allow blank match keys in screenshot album name.
